name: bld5_pisano_five_pow
informal: Uses Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd and Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period: key identity F_{5n} = 25F_n^5 + 25(-1)^n F_n^3 + 5F_n (over ℤ), whence by induction 5^j ∣ F_{5^j} but 5^(j+1) ∤ F_{5^j}. Upper bound: induct with the matrix/binomial argument (Q^{4·5^k} = 1 + 5^k•M ⇒ Q^{4·5^(k+1)} ≡ 1 mod 5^(k+1)), base F_20 = 6765, F_21 = 10946; then lib_fib_period_iff + bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period give pisano ∣ 4·5^(k+1). Lower bound by induction: bld3_pisano_dvd_pisano_of_dvd gives 4·5^k ∣ pisano(5^(k+1)) ∣ 4·5^(k+1), so the quotient is 1 or 5; if pisano = 4·5^k then (lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period, i = 0) 5^(k+1) ∣ F_{4·5^k}, and with 5^(k+1) ∣ F_{5^(k+1)} and Nat.fib_gcd this gives 5^(k+1) ∣ F_{5^k}, contradiction. Base pisano 5 = 20 by direct check of the divisors of 20.
